sources.backend: human_resource_management migrations 0011-0035 (permission seeds) and ecpmpapp/recette_bootstrap_catalogue.json (leave_request/staff_management base keys)

hr.name: Responsable RH — Recette
hr.description: Recette only. HR tester: leaves (incl. review), staff records, HR documents, compensation, onboarding/offboarding, leave reminders, workload. No SST, no full_access, no company configuration.

sst.name: Référent SST — Recette
sst.description: Recette only. Explicit, separate SST scope (cases, dossier, payroll projection, payroll attestation). Never granted to the Company Owner.

leave_request.view_created.description: Can view leave requests created by user
leave_request.view_created.name: View Created Leave Request

leave_request.update.description: Can modify a leave request's own content (dates, duration, type, reason, attachments) -- distinct from leave_request.review (approve/reject) and from leave_request.full_access (which also implies it). Never grants approval/rejection rights.
leave_request.update.name: Update Leave Request Content

leave_request.review.description: Can review and approve leave requests
leave_request.review.name: Review Leave Request

staff_management.create.description: Can create a Staff dossier for a User already attached to this company who does not yet have one -- a DELIBERATELY separate right from staff_management.view/update/full_access, which only ever govern an ALREADY-EXISTING dossier. Never implies compensation, role, license or company-assignment rights. Never assigned by default.
staff_management.create.name: Create Staff Dossier

staff_management.view_documents.description: Can view a company's/collaborator's HR documents (shared or private) -- a DELIBERATELY separate right from staff_management.view/full_access AND from view_compensation. Never grants access to compensation figures or health/SST notes, which remain under their own dedicated rights. Never assigned by default.
staff_management.view_documents.name: View Staff Documents

staff_management.update_documents.description: Can upload/rename/verify/accept a collaborator's HR documents and grant/revoke individual access to them. Separate from view_documents. The collaborator concerned may still upload their OWN requested pieces without this right, but can never verify/accept their own document (see can_transition_staff_document_file_status).
staff_management.update_documents.name: Manage Staff Documents

staff_management.view_compensation.description: Can view salary/hourly_rate for staff of this company -- a DELIBERATELY separate right from staff_management.view/full_access, which no longer implies compensation visibility (DEC-02/06). Never assigned by default.
staff_management.view_compensation.name: View Staff Compensation

staff_management.update_compensation.description: Can modify salary/hourly_rate for OTHER staff of this company (never one's own -- see DEC-04, a self-edit of one's own compensation is always refused regardless of this permission). Separate from view_compensation.
staff_management.update_compensation.name: Update Staff Compensation

staff_management.export_compensation.description: Can include salary in a generated Staff export file (DEC-49: export is its own action, never implied by view/update compensation rights).
staff_management.export_compensation.name: Export Staff Compensation

staff_management.manage_onboarding_templ.description: Can create/edit a company's onboarding templates. Never implies the right to trigger one.
staff_management.manage_onboarding_templ.name: Manage Onboarding Templates

staff_management.onboarding_trigger.description: Can launch an onboarding instance for an existing Staff dossier. Never implies managing templates.
staff_management.onboarding_trigger.name: Trigger Onboarding

staff_management.onboarding_view_all.description: RH global tracking view across every onboarding instance of the company. Acting on one's OWN assigned steps never requires this right -- assignment itself is sufficient authorization for that narrower case.
staff_management.onboarding_view_all.name: View All Onboarding Instances

staff_management.manage_offboarding_temp.description: Can create/edit a company's offboarding templates. Separate from staff_management.manage_onboarding_templates -- never cumulated by default. Never implies the right to trigger a departure.
staff_management.manage_offboarding_temp.name: Manage Offboarding Templates

staff_management.offboarding_trigger.description: Can launch an offboarding instance for an existing Staff dossier (manual trigger). Separate from staff_management.onboarding_trigger -- never cumulated by default. Never implies managing templates.
staff_management.offboarding_trigger.name: Trigger Offboarding

staff_management.offboarding_view_all.description: RH global tracking view across every offboarding instance of the company (the departures dashboard). Separate from staff_management.onboarding_view_all. Acting on one's OWN assigned steps never requires this right.
staff_management.offboarding_view_all.name: View All Offboarding Instances

staff_management.manage_leave_reminders.description: Can configure leave-balance reminder rules, preview/manually trigger reminders for the company's staff, and view the administrative delivery history. Does not grant staff_management.update/full_access (contractual-field editing) and never exposes salary/hourly_rate.
staff_management.manage_leave_reminders.name: Manage Leave Balance Reminders

staff_management.view_workload.description: Can view the read-only cross-project staff occupancy view (capacity/charge/rate from Project Management action items, estimated and clearly flagged as such). Grants no assignment or budget-editing right anywhere -- Project Management permissions are unchanged and still govern that. Never exposes salary/hourly_rate or absence justification details.
staff_management.view_workload.name: View Staff Workload

staff_management.manage_workload_alerts.description: Can configure which RH users receive the staff-workload overload alert for a company/solution, and trigger a manual recompute (shares the exact same anti-duplicate claim as the scheduled evaluation). Does not by itself grant staff_management.view_workload -- consulting the occupancy view still requires that separate, dedicated permission.
staff_management.manage_workload_alerts.name: Manage Staff Workload Alerts

staff_management.manage_sst_cases.description: RH/DRH habilitee: declare/record/correct/cancel/close an SST case (maladie/maladie longue duree/maternite/accident du travail/incident) for any staff of her own company. Deliberately separate from staff_management.view/update/full_access, view_documents, view_compensation, and every onboarding/offboarding permission -- never has a Company Admin fallback either.
staff_management.manage_sst_cases.name: Manage SST Cases

staff_management.view_sst_dossier.description: Read-only consultation of an SST dossier/documents -- narrower than manage_sst_cases (can consult, never record/correct/close). manage_sst_cases implies this.
staff_management.view_sst_dossier.name: View SST Dossier

staff_management.view_sst_payroll_projec.description: Paie: the narrow administrative projection (dates + nature only, never reason/notes/documents). Deliberately SEPARATE from manage_sst_payroll_attestation -- viewing the projection never implies the right to deposit an attestation, and vice versa.
staff_management.view_sst_payroll_projec.name: View SST Payroll Projection

staff_management.manage_sst_payroll_atte.description: Paie: deposit the salary attestation document for an SST case only -- never implies view_sst_payroll_projection nor any dossier/document read access.
staff_management.manage_sst_payroll_atte.name: Deposit SST Payroll Attestation
